title: Young Girl Daisy, Puffed Sleeve Garden Dress - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait of a young Asian girl named Daisy standing in front of a blooming garden shrub, likely a hibiscus bush. She wears a neat, collared mid-century dress with puffed sleeves, paired with white ankle socks, dark shoes, and a light ribbon in her hair. Her gentle smile and formal stance reflect classic mid-20th-century family snapshot portraiture. The reverse side features the name 'Daisy' written in cursive.
